prompt: With arm1, inspect vial1 with microscope, then send channel "log" the time of day the inspection was done.
blockers: the world has no clock, so a `time` reading fails the step (fail closed)
why: A `time` reading needs the world's `clock`. The world has none, so the step fails closed (0042 T7). `elapsed` would still work, but the request asks for the time of day. Compare `k01`, the same request in a world with a clock.
